newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open flat to 0.05 lower.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open flat to 0.05 lower.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open flat to 0.05 cent weaker Tuesday, traders said.

While fund selling may pressure the benchmark October contract through its downside target of 11.00 to 10.96 cents a lb in early dealings, trade buying is likely to buoy the contract back toward 11.00 cents during the session.
Monday, October ended 0.12 cent lower at 11.06 cents after trading from 11.20 cents to 11.06 cents. The rest lost 0.02 to 0.10 cent.

LIFFE white sugar futures eased slightly Tuesday, with against actuals accounting for the bulk of early volume, traders said. At 0842 EDT/1242 GMT, LIFFE August stood $1.10 lower at $318.00. October was down 50 cents to $315.00.
